plan_a_advantages: More total running volume, particularly in long runs, directly contributing to endurance.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It prioritizes longer, more sustained trail runs, which are crucial for building the endurance and specific adaptations needed for trail racing. Plan B, while including some valuable threshold work, focuses heavily on shorter, more intense sessions, potentially leading to overtraining and neglecting the crucial element of time on feet at race pace. Plan A’s emphasis on longer runs with varying intensities better simulates the demands of a trail race, while Plan B’s structure feels more geared towards building a strong aerobic base without enough race-specific volume.
